title: たくさんの彩りの中で

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home from a day out with Satono Diamond, we stop by the shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There are so many shops in here that it makes my head spin! But I'll definitely visit them all some da—oh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Whaddya think of this one? Doesn't it look mature? Or maybe this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Satono incoming! Hey-ho! ☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mayano! Hey, Creek! Doing a little shopping?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. That's right! Creek's picking out some mature clothes for me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But I can't decide. I just want everything I see! ☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm at a bit of a loss too—the problem is that Maya looks so cute in any outfit she wears.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So that's it! Then perhaps I could help. I'd love to find the perfect outfit for you, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Satono Diamond helps Mayano Top Gun shop for clothes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… This is more difficult than I thought. I can normally decide on outfits for myself rather quickly…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I suppose everyone has different standards when choosing clothes for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What do you think I should focus on, Trainer?
choice_data_list: An outfit that suits Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That makes sense. Deciding on a theme for the outfit is important!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Then, let me go back to the drawing board! Hehe. What to choose, what to choose. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've decided! What do you think of this outfit, Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond assembles an outfit using a combination of items with subdued colors.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! A white blouse with a navy blue skirt! It's so chic and mature!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The high-waisted skirt will make my legs look longer, too. This is sure to boost my allure. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: An outfit like this could totally work for me! Thanks for opening my eyes to new possibilities. ☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm so glad you like it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But how did you put together such a mature-looking outfit so easily?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well… I think it's because as a member of the Satono family, I often have to appear in public.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Not to mention, most of the guests that attend our social gatherings are adults.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I tend to opt for elegant color combinations so that I fit in with everybody else.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oooh! "Social gathering" has such a mature ring to it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, I wonder if one day I'll be able to attend one as a sophisticated adult.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course you will! We frequently invite Umamusume who are active in the world of racing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really?! Then, I've gotta make sure I'm ready for my high society debut! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Satono, I want you to teach me how to put together all kinds of mature outfits! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Not a problem! I'll give you all the knowledge you need!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Look at how exuberant they are. They're both so adorable. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see! I suppose it would be pointless if I don't choose something that suits the wearer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I'll need to think long and hard about this. Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've decided! What do you think of this outfit, Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond creates an outfit using a combination of cute and vibrant items.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I personally think the ruffles are really cute. Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wow! It's so lovely! And the bows on the sleeves are a real nice touch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I think so too! You've got a good eye!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The bows don't clash with the cuffs, so I thought they'd make perfect adornments. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Right, right! And the pants are on the shorter side, just how I like them. They're so cute! ☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And if we were to choose footwear to match…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Oh, I know! Ankle boots, right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Exactly! You really get it, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The pants are short, so I thought that pairing them with ankle boots would help to make your legs look longer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mm-hm! I totally getcha! Plus, showing off my legs might boost my allure a little!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I think we've got similar tastes, Satono. ☆ Hey, let's look around for more outfits together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It would be my pleasure! Let's start over there and work our way around. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Look at how exuberant they are. They're both so adorable. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Creek! Would you like to tag along with us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the four of us enjoy some time shopping for clothes together.
